product.title: Miami Pirate Boat Tour: Skyline & Celebrity Homes
product.description: Cruise through Biscayne Bay on a pirate-themed sightseeing boat and take in the Miami skyline from the water. The route passes well-known waterfront districts and celebrity-home zones, pairing narrated highlights with a relaxed onboard atmosphere.
highlights: Pirate-themed sightseeing cruise on Biscayne Bay
Views of Star Island, Venetian Islands, and downtown skyline
Great option for families and first-time visitors to Miami
Onboard music and bilingual tour guidance

itineraryItems.title: Bayside departure
itineraryItems.description: Board at the Bayside area and depart with a narrated introduction to the route.

itineraryItems.title: Celebrity homes and skyline cruise
itineraryItems.description: Pass by Star Island, Venetian Islands, and major waterfront viewpoints.

itineraryItems.title: Return to meeting point
itineraryItems.description: Cruise back to the original departure pier.

additionalInfo: Check-in is typically 30 minutes before departure
This activity generally operates in most weather conditions
Ages 21+ are required to consume alcohol

faqs.question: Where is the departure point?
faqs.answer: The tour departs from El Loro Pirate Ship at 401 Biscayne Blvd in Miami.

faqs.question: How long is the cruise?
faqs.answer: The experience is approximately 1 hour 20 minutes from departure to return.

faqs.question: What landmarks are typically seen during the route?
faqs.answer: The cruise commonly passes Star Island, Venetian Islands, Miami Beach, and downtown waterfront areas.

faqs.question: Is this tour suitable for families?
faqs.answer: Yes. The cruise is designed as a general sightseeing experience and is popular with families and groups.
